title.value: I WISDM: ASSESSING INSTRUCTION FOLLOWING IN MULTIMODAL MODELS AT SCALE
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the main focus of the paper, which is on assessing instruction following in multimodal models at scale using a new environment called iWISDM.
title.quote: To bridge this gap, we introduce the instructed-Virtual VISual Decision Making (iWISDM) environment engineered to generate a limitless array of vision-language tasks of varying complexity.

analysis.description: The paper presents iWISDM, an environment for assessing instruction following in multimodal models at scale. iWISDM generates various vision-language tasks of differing complexity and compiles benchmarks to evaluate multimodal models. The study identifies a gap between models' ability to follow instructions and human performance.

type.justification: The research involves empirical evaluations of several multimodal models using the newly created iWISDM benchmarks.
type.quote: Using iWISDM, we compiled three distinct benchmarks of instruction following visual tasks across varying complexity levels and evaluated several newly developed multimodal models on these benchmarks.

name.justification: The paper focuses on evaluating multimodal models, which deal with integrating and processing information across different modalities such as language and vision.
name.quote: Large language models and their more recent multimodal counterparts that integrate textual and visual inputs have achieved unprecedented success in performing complex tasks.

name.justification: The paper’s primary focus is on evaluating models' ability to follow instructions across different modalities.
name.quote: We introduce iWISDM, a virtual environment for the procedural generation of limitless visual decision-making tasks accompanied by natural language instructions.

name.justification: The paper specifically contributes by developing new benchmarks using iWISDM to assess multimodal models.
name.quote: Using iWISDM, we compiled three distinct benchmarks of instruction following visual tasks across varying complexity levels and evaluated several newly developed multimodal models on these benchmarks.

name.justification: iWISDM is the core contribution of the paper, serving as both a benchmark generator and evaluation environment for multimodal models.
name.quote: We introduce iWISDM, a virtual environment for the procedural generation of limitless visual decision-making tasks accompanied by natural language instructions.
